policy: Each path has one owner. Stage 0 package-specific new tests keep their package owner; existing tests use WP13v. A new path or owner transfer must be recorded before an edit. Protected paths have no edit owner.

data_handoff.rule: WP00a acts as data owner for S0-I only; later data edits return to WP16.

frame_switch: FrameNext becomes final; RFrameExact/RFrame keep text and become legacy. Exact deep exceptions are WP00c data.
